title: Crunchy Squash Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful side dish made with crunchy squash, a delicious twist on traditional fried fritters.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine squash, bread, cheese, eggs, onion, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
